timeline.title: Compressor unit trip at CS-1
timeline.text: One of three compressor units at CS-1 trips. Compression capacity drops by a third while the field keeps sending gas.

timeline.title: Lease crew 4 started: CS-1
timeline.text: 1 compressor unit(s) tripped - restart - restores full capacity (not a bottleneck right now)

timeline.title: ESP on PAD-11 W-01 starts degrading fast
timeline.text: Bearing wear accelerates on a high-rate pump. Only vibration telemetry reveals it.

timeline.title: Injectivity loss at SWD-2
timeline.text: Formation plugging cuts the injection capacity of SWD-2 by more than half. Nothing announces it - the twin has to notice.

timeline.title: Pipeline maintenance notice: Waha gas turns negative
timeline.text: A midstream maintenance notice pushes the Waha hub price to -2.50 USD/Mscf for 24 hours starting in 4 hours.

timeline.title: Negative gas price in effect
timeline.text: Every Mscf sold now costs money.

timeline.title: New well tied in on PAD-07
timeline.text: A new well is brought online by the completions team. It is not in any engineering database yet - only its SCADA tags appear.

timeline.title: Discovery: P07_W11
Compressor unit trip at CS-2
timeline.text: Second compression event during the negative-price window.

timeline.title: Lease crew 1 started: CS-2
timeline.text: 1 compressor unit(s) tripped - restart - restoring is worth $16/h at current bottlenecks
